2610.09590.title: Learning Situation-Conditioned Thinking Policies for Long-Term LLM Agents
2610.09590.paper_summary: Long-running autonomous agents must reuse accumulated reasoning experience without allowing explicit historical memory and LLM context to grow indefinitely. However, existing memory mechanisms mainly retrieve, summarize, or compress past content and do not directly learn when particular kinds of thinking should be activated or discover new thinking knowledge from temporally dispersed experiences. This paper proposes a situation-conditioned thinking memory framework that transforms historical reasoning experience into a lightweight policy for predicting what should be thought about in the current situation, while leaving detailed reasoning to a large language model. Situations may represent temporal or spatiotemporal evolution rather than only current states. Temporary experiences are also periodically analyzed across multiple independent episodes to identify repeated long-range regularities, which are consolidated into new thinking knowledge and further internalized by the lightweight policy. Experiments show that the learned policy achieves 1.000 F1 on temporal-rule generalization, improves DeepSeek reasoning F1 from 0.789 to 0.868, reduces online processing time from 0.3636 ms to 0.0382 ms per query at 30,000 historical situations, and reaches 1.000 relation-discovery F1 and future-thinking accuracy after sufficient repeated cross-experience evidence.
2610.09590.paper_summary_zh: 長期運行的自主代理必須重用累積的推理經驗，而不允許明確的歷史記憶和大型語言模型的上下文無限制地增長。然後，現有的記憶機制主要是檢索、總結或壓縮過去的內容，並不直接學習何時應該啟動特定類型的思維，或從時間上分散的經驗中發現新的思維知識。本文提出了一種情境條件的思維記憶框架，將歷史推理經驗轉化為一種輕量級策略，以預測在當前情境中應該思考什麼，同時將詳細的推理留給大型語言模型。情境可以表示時間或時空的演變，而不僅僅是當前狀態。臨時經驗也會定期在多個獨立的情節中進行分析，以識別重複的長期規律，這些規律被整合為新的思維知識，並進一步被輕量級策略內化。實驗顯示，所學習的策略在時間規則泛化上達到1.000 F1，將DeepSeek推理的F1從0.789提高到0.868，將在線處理時間從每個查詢0.3636毫秒減少到0.0382毫秒，並在足夠的重複交叉經驗證據後達到1.000的關係發現F1和未來思考準確率。
2610.09590.author: Hong Su et.al.
